## TRA Timeline

#### MDC / Stagwell combination and TRA execution

- 2021-07-13: Form-of TRA embedded as Annex M inside the 424B3 prospectus with bracketed parties and placeholder date
- 2021-08-02: MDC / Stagwell combination closes; TRA executed at 85% sharing rate with Midas OpCo Holdings LLC and Stagwell Media LP, covering Section 754 basis adjustments from Paired Equity Interest exchanges and imputed interest

#### Initial accrual phase

- 2022-Q1: First exchanges of Paired Units; initial TRA liability of $20.8M recorded

#### Final Class C exchange and shift to active payment

- 2025-04-04: Final Class C Exchange; all remaining Paired Units exchanged for Class A Common Stock; TRA liability jumps by ~$229.7M (revised figure per FY2025 10-K) to $254.9M at year-end 2025
- 2026-Q1: First $2.6M cash payment under the TRA

## Explanation

Stagwell Inc. (formerly MDC Partners Inc., then MDC Stagwell Holdings Inc.) executed a Tax Receivable Agreement on August 2, 2021 at the closing of the MDC / Stagwell combination, paying 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits to Stagwell Media LP (Mark Penn's vehicle) for Section 754 basis adjustments from exchanges of Paired Equity Interests (OpCo Common Units paired with Class C Common Stock) plus imputed interest. The contract has no amendments, restatements, or termination instruments. The TRA accrued gradually from $20.8M at Q1 2022 to $26.7M at FY2024 year-end, then jumped to $254.9M at FY2025 year-end when Stagwell Media exercised a final Class C Exchange of all remaining Paired Units on April 4, 2025, generating ~$229.7M of new basis step-up liability. Q1 2026 saw the first cash payment of $2.6M. The TRA remains in force and is transitioning from accrual to active payment phase. See `contract_log.md` for the executed text and the liability trajectory.
